Container.Name: wishlist
Container.Overview: Every wishlist, in one place. A self-hosted, iOS-style shopping wishlist PWA: paste a link to any product and it saves the photo, price, brand and store. Multiple lists with totals, auto-tagging, price-drop tracking, currency conversion, multi-user with live sync, and shareable read-only lists.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port the web app listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and saved product images. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Price check interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often prices are re-checked in the background. 0 turns it off.

Config.Name: Headless browser URL
Config.Description: Optional. Chrome DevTools address for stores that block simple scrapers, e.g. http://wishlist-chrome:9222 (see README).

Config.Name: Allow sign-ups
Config.Description: Let anyone create an account from the sign-in page. Admins can also toggle this in Settings.
